clips.text: Captain Marvel arrives.
Robots march in.
She glows.
He bows.
Chun-Li glows blue. Captain Marvel ignites. Their blast surges forward.
Rings trap robots.
Robots swoop in.
Thor flings a robot aside.
Lightning. Arthur charges.
The soldiers charge.
Soldiers charge.
An explosion.
Iron Man straightens up.
Soldiers face a robot.
Spencer winds up.
They head down the road.
Hawkeye's arrow bursts overhead.
Captain America smashes a robot.
Cap punches, then swings his shield.
Fallen soldiers.
A cloaked woman.
A horned figure in purple.
Blue light swirls between the trees.
A gold-armored figure climbs toward a hooded woman.
The stone reaches his palm. A white flash.
A blue portal frames a city.
She turns. Her eyes glow white.
The demon turns and spreads his arms.
Death looks down from a ledge of bones.
Death holds out a glowing blue Stone.
Blue light pools between standing stones.
The pool reveals a city.
Ultron and Thanos stand by a glowing pool.
Thanos raises his fist. Blue light floods the room.
They float above a crystal city.
Ultron flickers.
Sigma points a green blade at Ultron.
In a lab, Ultron approaches Sigma.
Ultron grabs Sigma's head.
Sparks burst around them.
Purple energy crackles around Ultron's fist.
Thanos watches. A body lies on the floor.
Ultron's armor pulses pink.
A blue Stone rises from a fallen hand.
Ultron Sigma holds a red and a blue Stone.
Red and blue lightning bursts from the Stones.
A massive armored figure emerges from the flash.
Iron Man kneels beside Strider.
X lifts and throws the shield.
Cap lands beside X.
Chun-Li squares up.
Her spinning kick scatters the robots.
One robot gets up. Spider-Man dives.
Doctor Strange appears.
Soldiers glow pink in a golden throne room.
Ultron Sigma's second face fills his chest.
Thor rises with his hammer raised.
Thor lands beside Arthur.
Dante slashes through the robots.
Dante tosses his pistols.
Rocket catches them.
He fires both.
Chris aims his pistol at the robots.
Thor batters the soldiers.
A blue blast hits a flying robot.
Captain America swats a robot aside.
Chris shoots a leaping robot and lands on the ledge.
Chris raises his hand.
An orange magic circle opens.
Chris checks a stone corridor, pistol raised.
Strider crouches behind him.
Chun-Li glances back.
Strange and Rocket advance past walls crackling pink.
Robots descend; soldiers advance.
They brace as Strange conjures magic.
Chris reaches a sealed door.
Chris presses the lock. The door opens.
Thanos hangs in glowing restraints.
Cap's team fights on the rainbow road.
Hawkeye draws his bow.
Hawkeye fires. Ultron Sigma blocks the arrow.
Sigma swats Cap aside as Thor charges.
He deflects fire, then flings an attacker aside.
Dante locks blades with Sigma, who knocks him down.
Arthur charges. Sigma swats him aside.
Cap launches X, who fires.
X lies at Sigma's feet; his blade rises.
Iron Man dives in; Sigma knocks him down.
A blast hurls Cap back.
Sigma's soldiers advance.
Pink veins spread over a soldier's skin and armor.
Soldiers stride past the fallen heroes.
A fallen soldier rises, pink veins glowing.
Spencer joins Thor.
Thor reaches for his hammer.
Sigma blocks him with a boot.
Sigma bathes Thor in pink energy. Thor pushes himself up.
Sigma spreads his arms; a pink blast erupts.
Strider lifts Thor as the others flee.
Smoke engulfs their golden circle.
Only Sigma's soldiers remain.
Heroes gather beneath a blue globe.
Captain America and Captain Marvel stride forward.
They approach a hologram. X follows.
Captain America touches Thor's arm.
A bearded blue hologram speaks.
Thanos hangs masked inside a glowing cell.
Iron Man holds out a glowing palm.
Cap faces Iron Man.
Thor catches and raises his hammer.
Pink veins glow.
Cap approaches the cell holding Thanos.
Strange casts orange magic at the mask.
The mask falls away.
Purple energy engulfs Thor.
His eyes glow pink.
Thor glows pink, hammer raised.
Arthur and Hawkeye brace.
Sigma fills the screens.
Blue light flashes. Thor vanishes, and the heroes rush in.
Hawkeye and Arthur stand with the others.
Domed hall.
Avengers emblem.
A Quinjet waits on the roof.
Nova and Gamora step off.
Gamora lowers her eyes.
The group walks across the pad, Rocket trailing behind.
Gamora faces a cell holding Thanos.
Red and blue Stones blaze in Sigma armor.
Robot ranks.
Red-eyed Thor stands by the throne.
Drones launch from the throne.
X raises one finger.
Rocket pokes the blaster.
Strider and Gamora vanish in light.
They reappear among robots.
Wreckage skids past Strider.
Strider dashes away.
X and Rocket run between pillars.
Captain Marvel swoops down.
Nova touches down. Rocket and X peek around a pillar.
Zero blocks them.
The flyers leave.
Rocket aims at Zero.
Zero lies crumpled on the floor. X rushes over and cradles him.
Captain Marvel and Nova fly down a long corridor.
They face a giant sphere crackling with pink energy.
A hooded figure descends between drones.
Robots close in.
Strider lands above.
Gamora stands on another spire.
Purple energy erupts. Strider and Gamora leap at him.
The glowing pod bursts into purple shards and goes dark.
X holds Zero upright.
Nova and Captain Marvel look back.
Figures stand before a vast vault crackling with pink lightning.
A purple core.
Rocket holds the Stone.
The core sparks; smoke floods the room.
Emergency appears on screen.
X turns.
Chris creeps into a dark corridor, pistol raised.
Spider-Man hangs upside down behind him.
Spider-Man strolls off.
Two hulking soldiers approach.
Chris drops a creature with gunfire. Spider-Man lands beside him.
A webbed panel. A man jumps out.
Spider-Man webs the camera away and photographs Frank.
Frank photographs Chris walking away.
Frank snaps photos in a hall of enormous tanks.
A red mutant floats inside a tank.
Haggar lies in a pod, eyes shut.
Haggar wakes, bursting out as Frank falls.
Haggar chokes Frank.
Chris leaps up; Haggar throws him off.
They hide and peer out.
A cloaked figure materializes.
It floats away.
The heroes leap toward MODOK.
Mutant creatures close in.
A huge figure walks past fallen bodies.
A scarred, lipless face.
Chris aims his pistol.
Haggar throws Nemesis to the floor.
A web snatches the gem.
Green liquid churns below.
Frank bats the console.
Green light floods the floor.
Green fog swallows them.
A bearded scientist glows as a blue hologram.
Spencer adjusts his sparking bionic arm.
Robots swarm between city towers.
Hawkeye readies his bow.
Hawkeye fires.
Drones strike a glowing shield.
Robots smash through the windows. Iron Man fires.
Ultron Sigma lands.
Sigma grips the glowing cell barrier.
Spencer grabs a cable.
Spencer opens fire; beams strike Sigma.
Iron Man joins him. Their beams converge, driving Sigma back.
Thanos steps out, free and armored in gold.
Thanos trades blows with Sigma, then slams him down.
He rains punches down amid red flashes.
A red beam flares.
Sigma flickers like a broken hologram.
Sigma turns solid again.
Sigma vanishes in pink light.
Flaming wheels skid across dark rocky ground.
Ghost Rider rides his burning motorcycle to a stop.
She drops down beside Ghost Rider.
She springs up onto the rocks.
Morrigan strokes his skull.
Ghost Rider pulls her hand away and turns.
Two Morrigans now flank him.
A blazing portal opens.
Dante draws two pistols.
She spreads her wings and takes flight.
Arthur pops up.
She sweeps past Arthur.
They cross a bridge over lava.
Arthur runs on. A pillar of fire erupts.
Ghost Rider bursts through the flames.
The others land beside him.
They approach a glowing gate wrapped in vines.
A giant fanged cocoon.
A winged figure looms above.
Dante fires at the cocoon.
Strange conjures fire.
Dormammu rises in flames.
Dormammu towers over Strange and Arthur.
The winged demon drops from the cocoon.
Strange conjures orange fire.
Bands of light spiral around the cocoon.
It flares red. He sinks into a green vortex.
Green light floods out.
Strange raises a glowing hand.
The heroes leap into a portal.
The hunter leads Ryu into a desert town.
Ryu approaches a caped figure.
Black Panther turns.
Hulk leaps down, roaring.
A huge blade blocks his punch.
Ryu raises his fists. Hulk charges.
An aircraft swoops low overhead.
The hunter joins them before a landed jet.
Heroes gather near the jet.
Cap and Chun-Li arrive.
Drones streak across the sky; the heroes look up.
Robots land; Cap and Chun-Li brace.
Chun-Li kicks a robot.
A shield strikes; purple gas erupts.
A robot head glows.
Hulk stomps.
The hunter crouches, touching the sand.
A giant spiked dragon bursts from the sand.
Drones dive toward the town.
Hulk smashes a robot gripping a villager.
Hulk grabs Ryu and leaps.
A giant spiked dragon erupts from the dunes.
Red energy surrounds Ryu.
Hulk launches Ryu skyward.
Ryu kicks the scaly hide.
Hulk strikes with glowing fists.
Ryu lands a glowing uppercut.
Hulk grabs a rock in midair.
Ryu fires a blue beam.
Hulk smashes down amid an explosion.
The dragon collapses into the dust.
Hulk lumbers over to Ryu.
Black Panther leads them through a dusty gate.
Chun-Li smiles at Black Panther.
Black Panther reveals the glowing Time Stone.
Cap takes the Stone and closes his fist.
Black Panther turns away.
A red warning sign above the hall.
The heroes drop from an orange portal.
Arthur steps forward.
Thanos walks past Arthur.
Chris and Spider-Man appear on screen.
Frank runs from an explosion. Spider-Man lands in the street.
Fire bursts around Jedah.
A horned beast towers over the buildings.
Its tongue lifts Spider-Man.
The beast stomps down the street.
Dante dives through a window.
Nova is on screen.
Captain America appears on screen.
The beast lunges. Chris dives for cover.
Chris fires a rocket into the beast.
Green light swirls in its chest.
Spider-Man wears a black suit.
Frank swings a bat.
Spider-Man strikes in black.
Spider-Man is red and blue again.
Stone in hand, Spider-Man swings away.
A pink beam flashes past. Spider-Man crashes onto the street.
Jedah descends above him.
Ghost Rider jumps his flaming bike. Morrigan dives beside him.
The demon faces the heroes.
A jet passes overhead.
Hulk drops from the jet.
Dante swings his sword, then fires.
He dissolves into purple smoke.
Arthur, Spencer and Strange emerge from a portal.
Cap arrives with Chun-Li and Ryu.
Iron Man flies out.
Cap reveals the green Time Stone.
The eyes of Thanos glow red.
Hulk hurls a car.
Morrigan swoops in and fires.
Spencer swings in. A claw knocks Arthur back.
Green slashes rake the beast. Ghost Rider lashes it with a flaming chain.
Strange casts orange rings of magic that bind the beast.
Iron Man and Nova fly in.
A purple beam hits.
A demon rises from purple goo.
The slash knocks Ryu and Hawkeye back.
Cap is on one knee.
Red light surrounds Ryu.
Ryu throws a pink fireball.
Fiery blasts engulf Jedah.
Thanos raises a fist.
The demon bursts into purple goo.
Thanos towers over Ryu.
Cap approaches Thanos.
Spencer swings past the beast.
Spider-Man swings toward the tower.
A jet lands on the roof.
Cap stands with Zero, Strider and X.
Thanos arrives with arms crossed.
A dark sphere looms.
Iron Man rises between Zero and X.
Iron Man, Zero and X raise their Stones.
The sphere plunges toward the city.
The heroes blast the beast.
Strange faces the falling sphere.
Orange bands of magic halt it.
Zero and X power up.
Iron Man raises a glowing hand.
Beams converge on Iron Man.
The beast hurtles skyward.
Iron Man rises in a blaze.
The sky erupts pink.
Cap raises his shield.
Pink mist covers the city.
A blue hologram glows in the damaged tower.
Cap rests a hand on Ryu's shoulder.
Dante descends the stairs with his sword on his shoulder.
The team gathers around the blue hologram.
Spider-Man sits on a couch beside Haggar.
Thanos raises a fist.
Dante and Iron Man high five.
Thanos walks beside Gamora.
Rocket waves to her.
X and Zero bump fists.
Strider climbs onto a rocky ledge.
Pink lightning crackles around a golden palace.
Captain Marvel takes flight.
Rocket hurries after them.
Ghost Rider walks with the team.
Spider-Man swings down beside Chun-Li.
Pink veins spread across the hand of Chris.
A golden palace crackles with pink lightning.
An army of robots blocks the way.
Nova and Chun-Li brace.
X blasts a robot.
A shot streaks toward the palace.
The heroes charge toward the palace.
Cap and Chris face the robots.
Robots swarm the glowing roads.
Lava flows under a purple sky.
Dante faces a winged demon at the throne.
Dante charges and slashes. Jedah hurls him to the ground.
Red lightning strikes the kneeling Dante.
Dante rises with wings.
Dante lunges and snatches the Stone.
Jedah clutches his chest.
A claw closes around the Stone.
Dante vanishes in red light.
A blueprint glows on the lab screen.
Gamora, Zero and Ryu walk out.
Iron Man walks toward Thanos.
Frank takes photos of the lab.
Thanos clenches his raised fist.
Frank hits the floor. Iron Man crawls nearby.
Thanos strides toward Iron Man.
Iron Man raises a green Stone.
Thanos takes it and holds it up.
A vision of Ultron Sigma, then Death beside the demon.
Ryu, Zero and Gamora rush in.
Iron Man gets up, holding his side.
Ryu and Gamora lie on the floor.
Thanos walks to a glowing pod.
Ryu pushes himself up.
Thanos raises a massive green gauntlet.
The gauntlet strikes Ryu.
The eyes of Ryu glow red.
Pink energy streams from Ryu into the gauntlet.
Thanos holds it up, glowing pink.
Ryu collapses.
Gamora points her pistol at Thanos.
Thanos tosses aside the green Stone.
Gamora stands alone, gun raised.
Gamora helps Ryu up.
Strange stands by a blazing portal.
Iron Man lifts off. The team follows.
Hulk and the heroes fight through a golden hall.
Ultron Sigma sits on a towering throne.
Thor approaches with his hammer. Pink veins glow across him.
His eyes glow pink too.
Thor slams down his hammer.
Ultron Sigma rises from the throne.
Hulk, Cap, Strider and X brace for a fight.
A pink beam hits Hulk. He stays upright.
Ultron Sigma spreads his arms before them.
Ultron Sigma steps down from the throne.
Dante walks in alone.
A fist closes around the orange Stone.
Dante walks back past Cap and Strider.
Ultron Sigma glows gold on the throne.
The robot bursts apart in golden light.
A giant metal face rises through the dust.
The robot looms above the giant face.
Spider-Man webs the Stone away.
A fist drives the Stone into Thor's chest.
Thor blazes with white light.
The pink veins are gone.
Thor lifts his hammer.
Purple energy lashes out.
X and the others emerge from a fiery portal.
Iron Man projects a glowing blueprint.
Orange magic glows in the hands of Strange.
Iron Man pushes the image toward X.
A huge cannon forms on his arm.
X presses a purple Stone into its socket.
Captain Marvel takes flight.
Strider and Gamora step forward.
Strider, Gamora and Thor send Stones flying.
The Stones lock into sockets on the cannon.
Iron Man steadies the cannon.
The cannon charges.
X strains in its light.
Golden armor forms around X.
Strange casts a ring of fire around them.
The heroes glow inside the circle.
Streams of fire pour into a sphere around X.
X fires a massive blast.
The blast tears into the giant machine.
X lies on the floor. Zero and Cap rush to him.
They kneel beside him.
Chris checks his hand.
Zero helps X to his feet.
Rocket peeks over a rock.
Rocket reaches for six glowing Stones.
Sunlight falls on a golden palace.
The heroes gather on the road.
Ryu puts a hand on Spider-Man's shoulder.
Cap, Chris, Ryu and Spider-Man walk away.
A rainbow arcs over the palace.
A dark castle under the stars.
A pale woman in a dark hood.
Thanos faces Death and the winged demon.
Pink energy flares around his gauntlet.
Thanos gathers a crackling pink orb.
The shield arcs past robots.
Captain America.
Robots explode along the road.
Strider slashes.
